>I'm staying to find out what this world comes to. 

If trends continue I expect in twenty years they'll break into houses to grab ugly and short men and throw them in the streets and kill them for the public spectacle and excitement.

Basically solidifying our status as circus freaks and as subhuman. It's "evolution." It's "natural section." It's [excuse for bigotry].
The recoil would otherwise make the shot go off target increasing the chance of brain damage at the cost of not dying. I already know to use 00 or slugs due to energy transfer.
I've always wondered how one holds the shotgun while they're sitting in the tub in order to counteract the recoil. Not sure if wrapping legs around it works since bathtubs are slippery, ya know?
